description: Minimal valid MT103 with only mandatory fields
test_coverage: Mandatory field 50K (Ordering Customer with account and name/address)
Mandatory field 59 (Beneficiary Customer with account and name/address)
Shared charges (SHA) - typical for SEPA-like transfers
business_rules_expected_to_pass: Currency code must be valid ISO 4217
Charge bearer must be valid code (BEN/OUR/SHA)
notes: This is the simplest possible valid MT103. All optional fields and blocks (3, 5) are omitted. Uses realistic but fictional BICs (DEUTDEFF for Deutsche Bank, BNPAFRPP for BNP Paribas), valid IBANs, and fictional customer names.
